items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: I brought it to a small Etude to Mozart. But that didn't lie to me.

ctx.x: After a while. After a while. After a while. I took my degree. Three months. And started reading. And then I started reading. And then I brought it to a small Etude to Mozart. But that didn't lie to me. And then I gave it again. And then I gave it again. And...
But you have enough enough foundation for the harmonies to understand. Not only after a hearing room.
